stages.name: Germination
stages.description: Radicle emergence and early cotyledon sprout development above soil surface.
stages.care_focus: High ambient humidity, warm soil (22-26°C), and gentle indirect light.

stages.name: Seedling
stages.description: First set of true botanical leaves established; initial root system anchor.
stages.care_focus: Filtered sunlight, careful bottom-watering to prevent damping off.

stages.name: Vegetative Growth
stages.description: Rapid stem elongation, internode expansion, and dense leaf canopy building.
stages.care_focus: Nitrogen-rich feeding, full sunlight (6+ hours), and structural staking.

stages.name: Bud Formation
stages.description: Floral meristem differentiation; reproductive flower buds emerge at nodes.
stages.care_focus: Phosphorus & potassium transition (NPK 5-10-10), stable watering schedule.

stages.name: Flowering
stages.description: Full anthesis and bloom opening; active insect/wind pollination window.
stages.care_focus: Consistent root moisture; avoid spraying water directly into open blooms.

stages.name: Fruiting
stages.description: Ovary swelling, fruit set, and active nutrient transport for seed development.
stages.care_focus: High potassium and calcium feeding; mulch to prevent soil-borne fruit rot.

stages.name: Mature Plant
stages.description: Full vegetative and reproductive height achieved; harvest readiness.
stages.care_focus: Pruning maintenance, harvesting ripe fruit, seed saving.
